intro.title: One Connected Business Instead of Disconnected Tools
paragraphs: Most businesses run on many separate systems: a website or online store, an accounting or ERP system, a CRM, payment gateways, courier partners, messaging tools and industry software. When they do not talk to each other, staff re-enter orders, invoices and customer details again and again, and mistakes and delays creep in.

API integration connects these systems so data moves between them automatically and in real time. An order on your website can create an invoice in accounting, book a courier pickup, update stock and send the customer a message, all without anyone touching it. We design, build and maintain these integrations, using REST, SOAP, GraphQL and webhooks, with proper security, error handling and monitoring.

We also build custom APIs for your own software, so partners, mobile apps and other systems can connect to it safely. Whether you need one third-party API integration or an integration layer across your whole business, see our <ces>enterprise software</ces> work or <contact>tell us which systems you want to connect</contact>.

faqs.title: API Integration FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about connecting your systems.

items.a: API integration connects two or more software systems through their APIs so they can share data and trigger actions automatically, for example sending website orders to accounting and courier systems without manual entry.

items.q: What types of API integrations do you build?
items.a: We build payment gateway, shipping and courier, ERP and accounting, CRM, ecommerce and marketplace, messaging and SMS, telephony, healthcare EHR/EMR, travel and booking, HR and payroll, and AI API integrations, plus custom APIs.

items.q: How much does API integration cost?
items.a: A single third-party integration typically costs $800 to $3,000, multi-system integrations $3,000 to $12,000, and integration platforms or custom APIs from $12,000, depending on complexity.

items.q: How long does an API integration take?
items.a: A single integration usually takes 1 to 3 weeks. Connecting several systems with two-way sync takes 3 to 8 weeks, and larger integration platforms 2 months or more.

items.q: What happens when a third-party API changes?
items.a: We monitor integrations and offer maintenance plans that update them when providers change their APIs, so your workflows keep running without interruption.

items.q: Can you build an API for our own software?
items.a: Yes. We design and build secure, documented REST or GraphQL APIs for your software, so your mobile apps, partners and other systems can integrate with it.
